notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-counter-increment-wrap (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): DCOUNTER with INCREMENT, GET WRAP at the default doubleword maximum (rewinds to the minimum), and a GET without WRAP at the limit.
